digest.component_or_area: commands, CLI, engine_support, and io modules
propositions: Module docstrings (16 instances) contain stale narration about non-existent bash dispatcher, ticket_txn.py, and Tier E cutover that must be relocated to docs/bash-migration.md or deleted with reason recorded.

Six individually-confirmed stale comments cite non-existent artifacts (shims, compat layers) or contradictory logic and must be corrected in place or deleted per decision rule (artifact-gone vs superseded).
The _engine_support/reads_cli.py contains five near-identical unknown-option validation blocks that should be collapsed into one shared helper function.
Stale comment lines must be removed to reduce module bloat in _commands/init.py (799→782 lines) and _cli/_llm_commands.py (789→778 lines) without requiring code extraction.
Every non-KEEP comment unit in scope must be dispositioned into exactly one of five labels (RELOCATE, DELETE, KEEP, DO_NOT_MOVE, CORRECT-IN-PLACE) with recorded reason for each deletion.
No load-bearing invariant or runtime behavior must be lost; full test suite and lint/typecheck must pass unchanged after cleanup.
